description: Implement Performance Dashboard with text-based ASCII charts for terminal output. Create a new text-based dashboard module that provides performance metrics visualization without requiring Ink/React, making it more portable and lightweight.
steps: Create lib/analyzers/performance-dashboard.js with text-based dashboard class that generates ASCII charts for terminal output
Implement metrics collection: analysis duration, file counts, token counts, cache hit rates
Implement ASCII chart generation for trends (bar charts, line charts using characters like ▓, ░, │, ─)
Implement bottleneck identification that identifies slow analysis phases
Add --perf-dashboard CLI flag to bin/cli.js that displays the text-based dashboard
Create test/performance-dashboard.test.js with comprehensive tests for dashboard functionality
Ensure all new tests pass with npm test
acceptance_criteria: lib/analyzers/performance-dashboard.js exists and exports PerformanceDashboard class
Dashboard displays total analyses count, average duration, cache hit rate
Dashboard includes ASCII trend charts (bar charts, sparklines)
Dashboard shows top bottlenecks and optimization recommendations
--perf-dashboard CLI flag works and displays the dashboard
test/performance-dashboard.test.js exists with passing tests covering all major functions
All 1121+ existing tests continue to pass
verification: Run npm test and verify all tests pass including new tests
Run node bin/cli.js --perf-dashboard to verify dashboard displays correctly
findings: All 1154 tests pass (33 new tests for performance dashboard). CLI flag --perf-dashboard works with --period option (7d, 30d, all) and --save-report option. Dashboard displays ASCII charts with sparklines, bar charts, phase breakdown, bottlenecks, and recommendations.
